string.name: tool_switched
string.description: Spoken when switching to another tool by voice; %1$s is the tool name, e.g. Mail reader

string.name: tool_connecting
string.description: Spoken on voice-first launch while connecting; %1$s is the tool name

string.name: tool_reconnecting
string.description: Spoken when reconnecting to use the camera

string.name: tool_ready
string.description: Spoken once the glasses are connected on voice-first launch

resources.string: Your glasses are ready. Say help at any time.

string.name: tool_welcome
string.description: Spoken when a tool opens with the glasses already streaming; %1$s is the tool name

string.name: tool_stream_lost
string.description: Spoken when the glasses camera stops

resources.string: The glasses camera stopped. I\'ll reconnect when the glasses are back.

string.name: tool_paused_by_glasses
string.description: Spoken when the glasses paused the camera

resources.string: The glasses paused the camera. Tap the side of the glasses to carry on.

string.name: tool_camera_back
string.description: Spoken when the glasses camera comes back

string.name: tool_camera_denied
string.description: Spoken when camera permission was refused

resources.string: Camera access wasn\'t allowed, so I can\'t see anything. Close and open me again to ask again.

string.name: tool_goodbye
string.description: Spoken when a tool closes by voice

string.name: tool_paused
string.description: Spoken after pausing by voice

string.name: tool_removed
string.description: Glasses taken off, generic tools

resources.string: You took your glasses off, so I\'ve paused. Put them on to carry on.

string.name: tool_disconnected
string.description: Glasses disconnected, generic tools

resources.string: Your glasses disconnected. Check they\'re on, unfolded and nearby.

string.name: tool_worn_again
string.description: Glasses put back on, generic tools

string.name: tool_too_hot
string.description: Glasses too hot, generic tools

resources.string: Your glasses are too hot, so I\'ve paused. Take them off for a few minutes to cool down.

string.name: tool_needs_setup
string.description: Spoken on voice-first launch when the app isn't registered with Meta AI; %1$s is the tool name

resources.string: %1$s needs a one-time setup with the Meta AI app before it can use your glasses. TalkBack works on this screen, or ask someone to help.

string.name: tool_not_ready
string.description: Spoken by a tool that isn't built yet; %1$s is the tool name

resources.string: %1$s isn\'t ready yet. You can say open the book reader, or close.

string.name: tool_ask_unavailable
string.description: Spoken when questions about the text can't be answered (not built yet)

string.name: tool_ask_not_in_text
string.description: Spoken when the text doesn't answer the question

string.name: tool_ask_nothing_read
string.description: Spoken when a question is asked before anything was read

resources.string: I haven\'t read anything yet, so I can\'t answer that.

string.name: tool_ask_failed
string.description: Spoken when answering a question failed

resources.string: Sorry, I couldn\'t answer that just now.

string.name: tool_close
string.description: Close button on a tool screen; %1$s is the tool name

string.name: tool_status_idle
string.description: Tool status line before anything happens

string.name: tools_heading
string.description: Heading above the tool buttons on the camera screen
